game.title: AI-Assisted Development with Claude Code
game.description: Test your understanding of how to effectively use Claude Code as an AI development partner — concepts, best practices, and a few reflection questions.

questions.prompt: What filename do you create at the root of a project to give Claude Code persistent, project-specific instructions that load automatically every conversation?
What does the /clear slash command do inside a Claude Code session?

options: Deletes any files Claude created during the session
Clears the conversation history to free up context window space
Removes Claude's memory files from your home directory
Signs you out of your Anthropic account

questions.prompt: Claude Code can execute shell commands, run your test suite, and install packages directly on your machine.
When you start a Claude Code session, it reads every file in your project into its context before answering your first question.
Which best describes Claude Code's 'plan mode'?

options: A mode where Claude writes a project plan document for you to review
A read-only mode where Claude explores the codebase and proposes an approach before making any changes
A restricted mode that prevents Claude from running any shell commands
An automated mode that activates when a task touches more than five files

questions.prompt: Claude Code can create git commits and new branches on your behalf within your local repository.
When working with Claude Code on a large, multi-step task, what is the recommended approach?

options: Give it the entire task at once and let it run completely uninterrupted
Break the work into logical steps, review changes at each checkpoint before continuing
Always write the code yourself first, then ask Claude to improve it
Avoid using Claude Code for any task that touches more than two files

questions.prompt: Which developer skill becomes MORE important, not less, when you have AI assistance like Claude Code available?

options: Memorizing exact syntax and API method names
Knowing which specific files contain which functions
Critically reading and evaluating generated code for correctness and security
Typing speed and keyboard shortcuts

questions.prompt: Which part of an AI-assisted development workflow have you personally found most valuable so far?

options: Generating boilerplate and scaffolding from scratch
Getting plain-English explanations of confusing code or error messages
Having Claude write and run tests automatically
Using Claude to review my code for bugs before I commit

questions.prompt: Complete this sentence honestly: "The biggest mistake a developer can make when using Claude Code is..."
In which of the following situations should you manually review Claude Code's output before accepting it? Select all that apply.

options: Before committing security-critical code changes
After asking Claude to explain what a simple function does
When Claude generates a database migration
When Claude suggests code that deletes or overwrites files
After running a basic npm install command

questions.prompt: Which of the following are useful things to include when asking Claude Code to fix a bug? Select all that apply.

options: The exact error message or stack trace
The file path of the relevant code
Your entire git history for context
What you've already tried
A description of the expected vs. actual behavior

questions.prompt: Which of these tasks have you actually tried using an AI coding tool for? Select all that apply.

options: Debugging error messages
Writing boilerplate or scaffolding
Understanding unfamiliar code
Writing unit tests
Refactoring existing code
